name: Word Wizard
description: Hear a word, tap the letters into place, and the right word casts a spell in a 3D world.

about.concept: Phonics and spelling with immediate feedback. The child hears a word, places its letters in order, and sees the right spelling act in a 3D world, so sound-to-letter mapping is practiced word by word.
about.progression: Three-letter words with short vowels lead to blends, longer words, two-word spells, endings, prefixes and compound words, then vowel teams, syllables, prefixes and suffixes, homophones chosen from a spoken sentence, Greek and Latin roots, academic vocabulary from a spoken definition, spelling demons typed on a letter keyboard, and word connotation and figurative language at 8th grade. The child starts at the rung that matches the reading grade a parent set and climbs with four right in a row.
